title: Your First Code Review
summary: Our first Code Review Club: a Nostr identity in one command, then a real Bitcoin pull request reviewed live, step by step.
share_text: How to review your first open-source PR: notes + every resource from the first @CodeOrangeDevs Code Review Club
tldr: Nostr is to X what Bitcoin is to a bank: you hold the key, nobody can ban your identity.
One command (nihao) gives you a Nostr identity, relays, a Lightning address and an ecash wallet.
Reviewing a PR starts with context, then build it, run the tests and try to break them.
Start contributing by reviewing, not coding. “I ran the tests and they pass” is a real review.
